title: Two independent four-field cyclic codes with adaptive decoding

claims.statement: The explicit product of two four-field degree-125 cyclic encoders and their shared radius-22 adaptive list decoder carry 1000 bits on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses with average block error at most 40187781602099041/125000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=2023494998507562943367847913067899202 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(120607/1000).
